proposal_metrics.note: Rates use recorded apply/discard events only. Proposals cannot currently be edited in-app, so modification_rate reflects fingerprint mismatches (normally 0).
proposal_metrics.claim: Do not treat LLM self-reported confidence as calibrated probability unless bucket outcomes demonstrate correlation.

notes: Graph validity for Synapse uses production build_topics_and_dependencies.
Topic matching is deterministic (normalize, aliases, token containment / Jaccard); no LLM judge.
Proposal metrics reflect real event-log data only; empty means nothing recorded yet.
The benchmark measures agreement with curated reference structures and does not claim that there is only one universally correct learning graph.
Multi-generation run: 3 independent generations per case (base seed=42; per-gen seed=base+repetition when supported). Per-generation rows are stored independently; measurement only (not best-of-N).
